; Extra macrotime oracle input. The v7 fixtures reach the standard `<+`
; rewrite once at most, so this file drives several claims in one wave and a
; claim nested under a form so the rewriter emits child overrides.

(: Action
   (* (: value int)))

(: Event
   (* (: value int)))

(: Other
   (* (: value int)))

(<+ (Action ?Value)
    (Event ?Value))

(<+ (Other ?Value)
    (Action ?Value))

(<- (Event ?Value)
    (<+ (Other ?Value)))
